requirement.description: The _get_all_users method has issues with error handling and returning None when it should return an empty list. The method is also duplicated in the file, causing conflicts with the implementation.
requirement.contract: Fix the _get_all_users method to properly handle errors and return an empty list instead of None when users cannot be retrieved. Remove the duplicate implementation of _get_all_users and _get_group_users methods to prevent conflicts.

requirement.description: The _get_group_users method has issues with error handling and returning None when it should return an empty list. It also doesn't properly validate the group name before making requests.
requirement.contract: Fix the _get_group_users method to properly handle errors and return an empty list instead of None when users cannot be retrieved. Add validation for group names to ensure they are not empty or invalid.

requirement.description: The _expand_targets method has issues with the logic for handling empty targets and groups. It's also duplicated in the file.
requirement.contract: Fix the _expand_targets method to correctly handle empty targets and groups. Remove the duplicate implementation to prevent conflicts.

requirement.description: There's a duplicate _is_valid_target method defined twice in the file, causing confusion and potential conflicts.
requirement.contract: Remove the duplicate _is_valid_target method definition to ensure only one implementation exists.

requirement.description: The API details method is not properly generating the plugin information for Nextcloud, causing test failures in the API verification test.
requirement.contract: Ensure the Nextcloud plugin properly implements all required metadata fields in its details() method to satisfy API verification requirements.
